_doc: Damage type x armour class, in percent. A Latin square: every damage type has exactly one strong (115) and one weak (90) armour, and every armour has exactly one of each, so no race is hard-countered by two heroes. Heroes deal their class type (Warrior blade, Ranger pierce, Pyromancer fire, Druid nature) and can coat their weapon with a shop Oil to change half of it. A hero's OWN armour class comes from the chest item it wears, so the units' damage types (melee blade, ranged pierce, casters fire/nature) matter too. Read by js/sim/combat.js and tools/econ-sim.mjs. `fortified` (champions only) takes 100% from everything: the match-ending unit is never decided on the pick screen.

chestArmour._doc: chest item base tier -> the hero's armour class
